comments.body: Closing — two enterprise tenants already scoped their CI keys to single projects.

content.text: Closing — two enterprise tenants already scoped their CI keys to single projects.
Workspace-wide API keys are too broad for contractors and CI jobs that should only touch a few projects or only read.
Allow API keys to declare project_ids allowlist and allowed_methods (subset of GET, POST, PATCH, PUT, DELETE). Requests outside the scope return 403 with code key_scope_violation.
Acceptance: empty project list means all projects (backward compatible); method list required at create; existing keys migrate as unrestricted; admin UI can edit scope without rotating the secret.
